free-coding.description: Free coding lane. Large-context free models first: nemotron-3-ultra took a 23k-token Claude Code payload and nemotron-3.5-lightning a 29k opencode one (JET-356, JET-358, 2026-09-06); groq gpt-oss-120b 413s above 8k TPM and codestral answers agentic turns with stubs, both kept as tail fallbacks.

free-thinking.description: Free reasoning lane for worker seats — only models that actually think, bonsai floor at the tail. The floor serves from connection `main` (localhost LM Studio, bonsai loaded at 262144, resident); the `jora` connection is parked (runtime connect failure + 128k serving context) — reactivate only on a proven node-fetch path as redundancy. Cos-class seats do NOT ride this lane (see cos-thinking): the floor's prefill is ~59 tok/s, so a 150k+ session is fatal here. Probe bonsai with max_tokens >= 1500 (reasoning model, small budgets return empty content). Refreshed 2026-09-14: opencode/nemotron-lightning/openrouter-free/oc-big-pickle/nex-pro all probed live; big-pickle 400-rot and oc delisting fixed same day.

cos-thinking.description: CoS-class lane (2026-09-14): cloud-only, priority, all 5 members >=200k context — for any seat whose runs can exceed ~120k tokens (CoS 137k peak, Captain, Economist 253k, Verifier 176k, Cold Reviewer 179k, Career Coach 130k, Researcher 126k). Exists because the free-thinking floor 400s >128k sessions; deliberately has NO local floor (local prefill too slow as mid-run fallback). Key gate: the free key's allowedCombos must list combo/cos-thinking.

free-cheap.description: Free fast/small lane for mechanical work — titles, classification, summaries.

subs-coding.description: Frontier coding on flat-rate subscriptions (Codex, Claude Max), falling through to the free coding lane when the subscription window is exhausted.

subs-thinking.description: Frontier reasoning on subscriptions, falling through to the strongest free reasoning models.

subs-cheap.description: Cheapest subscription tier for volume work; free/local floor underneath.
